content.short: Mirror World is a leading Web3 application development platform that helps developers build, grow and increase monetization in record time.
content.description: Mirror World is a full-stack Web3 app development platform that consolidates Web2/Web3 login, NFT marketplace, wallet integration, and NFT launches into a single SDK with minimal coding. Plug in once and complete integration in under 30 minutes, with APIs ready to use and accessible for your team. In addition to these core capabilities, the platform offers a UI dashboard, an open storefront, and data monitoring tools designed to minimize development effort and speed up time to market.
content.meta: Mirror World is a Web3 app platform for login, NFT marketplace, and wallet integration. Discover Mirror World and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
